title: Finite evaluation of the normalized identity open comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $X$. Use the strict coefficient-system derived categories, finite evaluation $e_n$, system open extension $J$, and open-evaluation mate $b_n:J_n\circ e_n\xrightarrow{\sim}e_n\circ J$ of [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization]. The index $n\in\mathbf N$ denotes the quotient of exponent $n+1$. Let $u:J_{\operatorname{id}_X}\cong1$ be the comparison obtained by left-adjoint uniqueness from the published system open adjunction and its identity pullback comparison. Let $a_n:(\operatorname{id}_X)_{!,n}\cong1$ be the section-normalized finite identity-open comparison [lem-trf-open-square-exchange]. Then for every $M\in D(\mathsf S_X)$, without boundedness or constructibility assumptions, $e_n(u_M)=a_{n,e_nM}\circ b_{n,M}^{-1}$.

proof.text: On ordinary modules, identity-open extension is sheafification of the original sheaf. Its comparison to identity is the unique extension of the identity on sections. The system and finite open adjunctions have exactly the corresponding section-normalized units.

Transpose the displayed two composites using the finite open adjunction. The leftAdjointUniq unit equation and the defining mate equation for open evaluation give the same pullback-evaluation unit on both sides. Identity pullback comparisons agree on sections; uniqueness of sheafification proves equality of their transposes.
Exact open extension and finite evaluation descend the ordinary square termwise to complexes and then to the unbounded derived categories. This gives the equation for all systems, including zero.

    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) (M : coefficientSequenceDerived l E X) :
    letI := systemOpenEvaluationInv_isIso l E (𝟙 X) n
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).map
        ((((systemDerivedOpenAdjunction l E (𝟙 X)).ofNatIsoRight
          (integralComparisonSystemUnit l E X)).leftAdjointUniq Adjunction.id).hom.app M) =
      (asIso (systemOpenEvaluationInv l E (𝟙 X) n)).inv.app M ≫
        (sfIntrinsicDerivedOpenId (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) X).hom.app
          ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).obj M)
